intro: This source-backed comparison evaluates iRobot Roomba Series and Roborock Robot Vacuum Series for buyers comparing warranty and support paths. verdict: Choose iRobot Roomba Series when scheduled floor maintenance with minimal daily handling is the leading requirement. Choose Roborock Robot Vacuum Series when automated vacuuming and optional mopping with detailed mapping matters more. For buyers comparing warranty and support paths, verify compatibility, support, current availability, and workload limits in the cited manufacturer documentation before purchase.
